strings: !This program cannot be run in DOS mode.

You are at sea. You look though your telescope to see another ship in the distance, you tell your captain of the ship and he orders you to signal it. the ship doesn't respond and it on an intercept course your captain notices they have their cannons pointed at the ship. He shout "GET DOWN!!!!!!".  The ship open fires to save your save you have to dive over board! As you hit the water the enemy ship hits the ships gun powder reserve and is destroyed and has left you stranded on an island. What do you do?
You have managed to kill the pirate hopefully no one heard you
You hit the Pirate and in turn he hits you
You trip your enemy up giving you a little bit of time to recouperate
Search the beach for other survivors
you are spotted by a pirate who readies his sword
You walk up and down the beach looking for survivors
After looking for survivors you notice a light off in the distance it looks like a lighthouse. You start walking towards it then you fall into a trap set by pirates
You have managed to break free
When you escaped you notice a ship and signal it. the boat docks at you escape the island
You wait on the beach for someone to come looking for you while waiting you have some food and drink. Hours pass, you have ran out of food and water again.
You run out of food and drink. You can't find anymore so you starve
You get get caught in a lots of vines and can't escape
You found some food and drink
